speaker: sinners
text: Come along, let us lie in wait for blood, let us ambush the innocent without cause,
name: Sinners

speaker: sinners
text: let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit.
name: Sinners

speaker: sinners
text: We will find all manner of precious goods; we will fill our houses with plunder.
name: Sinners

speaker: sinners
text: Throw in your lot with us; let us all share one purse
name: Sinners

speaker: wisdom
text: How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: If you had repented at my rebuke, then surely I would have poured out my spirit on you; I would have made my words known to you.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Because you refused my call, and no one took my outstretched hand,
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: because you neglected all my counsel, and wanted none of my correction,
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: in turn I will mock your calamity; I will sneer when terror strikes you,
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: when your dread comes like a storm, and your destruction like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish overwhelm you.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the LORD.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: They accepted none of my counsel; they despised all my reproof.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: So they will eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: For the waywardness of the simple will slay them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: But whoever listens to me will dwell in safety, secure from the fear of evil.
name: Wisdom

speaker: father
text: Let your heart lay hold of my words; keep my commands and you will live.
name: My father

speaker: father
text: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn from them.
name: My father

speaker: father
text: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will preserve you; love her, and she will guard you.
name: My father

speaker: father
text: Wisdom is supreme; so acquire wisdom. And whatever you may acquire, gain understanding.
name: My father

speaker: father
text: Prize her, and she will exalt you; if you embrace her, she will honor you.
name: My father

speaker: father
text: She will set a garland of grace on your head; she will present you with a crown of beauty.
name: My father

speaker: adulteress
text: I have made my peace offerings; today I have paid my vows.
name: The adulteress

speaker: adulteress
text: So I came out to meet you; I sought you, and I have found you.
name: The adulteress

speaker: adulteress
text: I have decked my bed with coverings, with colored linen from Egypt.
name: The adulteress

speaker: adulteress
text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, with aloes, and with cinnamon.
name: The adulteress

speaker: adulteress
text: Come, let us take our fill of love till morning. Let us delight in loving caresses!
name: The adulteress

speaker: adulteress
text: For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
name: The adulteress

speaker: adulteress
text: He took with him a bag of money and will not return till the moon is full.
name: The adulteress

speaker: wisdom
text: To you, O men, I call out, and my cry is to the sons of men.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: O simple ones, learn to be shrewd; O fools, gain understanding.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Listen, for I speak of noble things, and the opening of my lips will reveal right.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: For my mouth will speak the truth, and wickedness is detestable to my lips.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: All the words of my mouth are righteous; none are crooked or perverse.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: They are all plain to the discerning, and upright to those who find knowledge.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: For wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire compares with her.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight and strength.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: By me kings reign, and rulers enact just laws;
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: By me princes rule, and all nobles who govern justly.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: I love those who love me, and those who seek me early shall find me.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and righteousness.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: My fruit is better than gold, pure gold, and my harvest surpasses choice silver.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: The LORD created me as His first course, before His works of old.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: From everlasting I was established, from the beginning, before the earth began.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: When there were no watery depths, I was brought forth, when no springs were overflowing with water.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I was brought forth,
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: before He made the land or fields, or any of the dust of the earth.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: I was there when He established the heavens, when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep,
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: when He established the clouds above, when the fountains of the deep gushed forth,
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: when He set a boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not surpass His command, when He marked out the foundations of the earth.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Then I was a skilled craftsman at His side, and His delight day by day, rejoicing always in His presence.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: I was rejoicing in His whole world, delighting together in the sons of men.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Listen to instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: But he who fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.
name: Wisdom

speaker: wisdom
text: Leave your folly behind, and you will live; walk in the way of understanding.
name: Wisdom

speaker: folly
text: Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!
name: Folly

speaker: folly
text: Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is tasty!
name: Folly

speaker: slacker
text: There is a lion outside! I will be slain in the streets!
name: The slacker

speaker: drunkard
text: They struck me, but I feel no pain! They beat me, but I did not know it! When can I wake up to search for another drink?
name: The drunkard

speaker: slacker
text: A lion is in the road! A fierce lion roams the public square!
name: The slacker

speaker: agur
text: I am weary, O God, and worn out.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Surely I am the most ignorant of men, and I lack the understanding of a man.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: I have not learned wisdom, and I have no knowledge of the Holy One.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Who has ascended to heaven and come down? Who has gathered the wind in His hands? Who has bound up the waters in His cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is His name, and what is the name of His Son— surely you know!
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Do not add to His words, lest He rebuke you and prove you a liar.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Two things I ask of You— do not refuse me before I die:
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Keep falsehood and deceitful words far from me. Give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the bread that is my portion.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Otherwise, I may have too much and deny You, saying, ‘Who is the LORD?’ Or I may become poor and steal, profaning the name of my God.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Do not slander a servant to his master, or he will curse you, and you will bear the guilt.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: There is a generation of those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: There is a generation of those who are pure in their own eyes and yet unwashed of their filth.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: There is a generation—how haughty are their eyes and pretentious are their glances—
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: there is a generation whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are knives, devouring the oppressed from the earth and the needy from among men.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: The leech has two daughters: Give and Give. There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, ‘Enough!’:
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Sheol, the barren womb, land never satisfied with water, and fire that never says, ‘Enough!’
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: As for the eye that mocks a father and scorns obedience to a mother, may the ravens of the valley pluck it out and young vultures devour it.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: There are three things too wonderful for me, four that I cannot understand:
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a snake on a rock, the way of a ship at sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: This is the way of an adulteress: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Under three things the earth trembles, under four it cannot bear up:
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: a servant who becomes king, a fool who is filled with food,
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: an unloved woman who marries, and a maidservant who supplants her mistress.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: Four things on earth are small, yet they are exceedingly wise:
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: The ants are creatures of little strength, yet they store up their food in the summer;
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: the rock badgers are creatures of little power, yet they make their homes in the rocks;
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: the locusts have no king, yet they all advance in formation;
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: and the lizard can be caught in one’s hands, yet it is found in the palaces of kings.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: There are three things that are stately in their stride, and four that are impressive in their walk:
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: a lion, mighty among beasts, refusing to retreat before anything;
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: a strutting rooster; a he-goat; and a king with his army around him.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: If you have foolishly exalted yourself or if you have plotted evil, put your hand over your mouth.
name: Agur

speaker: agur
text: For as the churning of milk yields butter, and the twisting of the nose draws blood, so the stirring of anger brings forth strife.
name: Agur

speaker: husband
text: Many daughters have done noble things, but you surpass them all!
name: Her husband
